problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: String → Bool)
-- inputs
(s: String) :=
-- spec
let spec (result : Bool) :=
  result ↔
  (3 ≤ s.length) ∧
  ¬ (∃ i j, i < j ∧ j < s.length ∧ j - i ≤ 2 ∧ s.data[i]! = s.data[j]!)
-- program termination
∃ result,
  implementation s = result ∧
  spec result
